context.body: Provision for the people is followed immediately by judgment on the leaders.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: The LORD instructs Moses to speak to the rock, gives water, and says Moses and Aaron failed to believe and sanctify him.
observations.label: God gives water and judges leaders: action

observations.body: The people contend; Moses speaks harshly and strikes twice; the congregation drinks.
observations.label: God gives water and judges leaders: response

observations.body: speak to the rock · rebel · struck twice · sanctify me
observations.label: Words in Numbers 20:1–13

payload.posture: Read Numbers 20:1–13 as presence in the wilderness evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The source names unbelief and failed sanctification but does not reduce the failure to one isolated gesture.
payload.title: God gives water and judges leaders
